# Best desk charging setup for a laptop, phone, and watch

No single product in these results charges all three well. The wireless 3-in-1 stands handle a phone, watch, and earbuds but not a laptop. The laptop-capable chargers and hubs have no watch pad. The best setup is a wireless stand plus a laptop hub or charger.

## Phone + watch: wireless 3-in-1 stand (Apple devices)
- **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand** is WIRED's best overall. It charges an iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, with an AirPods spot on the base. It lists at $109 and was shown at $98, with $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station** is the cheap option. WIRED lists it at about $40 (down from $80), with a charger and cable included. The watch charger is a separate unit that slots into the back. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Anker MagGo / MagSafe 3-in-1 Qi2** is a good value pick. It includes a 40W adapter. The two guides disagree on price: one lists $89.99 with sales around $67-70, the other lists $100 with frequent drops to $35-45. Check the current price. [StandDeskLab](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/) · [The Office Journal](https://www.theofficejournal.com/guide/best-wireless-charging-stations-for-desk)

## Laptop: pick one
- **Anker 341 USB-C Hub (7-in-1)**, about $40, is the budget choice. It passes through up to 100W to the laptop and adds HDMI and an SD slot. [StandDeskLab](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/)
- **Belkin Connect USB-C 11-in-1 Pro GaN Dock**, about $138 on sale (normally $200), is a better fit if you also run monitors. It has 96W power delivery, supports up to three 4K displays, and has a built-in power supply with no big brick. [WIRED dock guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-laptop-docking-stations/)
- **Anker Prime 200W (6-port GaN)** is a wired alternative that charges a laptop and phone from one brick. The Office Journal rates it best overall for 2-3 devices, but I don't have a price for it. [The Office Journal](https://www.theofficejournal.com/guide/best-charging-stations-for-multiple-devices-desk)

## My pick
Get the **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 stand** (or the **ESR** to save money) with the **Anker 341 hub** if your laptop needs 100W or less. For a MacBook Pro 16" (about 140W), use a stronger charger or dock instead.

## Caveats
- The links above go to review pages, not retailer listings. I can't see direct purchase URLs in the results, so use the "shop" or "check price" buttons on those pages.
- The wireless stands are built for iPhone and Apple Watch. If you use an Android phone or a Galaxy/Pixel watch, tell me and I'll adjust.
- Check your laptop's wattage first. The Office Journal gives about 30-35W for a MacBook Air and 70W for a 14" MacBook Pro.

What laptop and phone do you have? I can narrow this to one exact combination.
